name: Pitt County, NC
findings: Pitt County has 525 nonprofit organizations. 203 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 166 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pitt County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 23 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Pitt County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 53 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 7 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
